info.title: NX-GameHide
info.author: chu3
info.description: Hide and restore games in the HOME menu through Tesla.
info.details:
Hide and restore games in the Nintendo Switch HOME menu through Tesla without deleting games or save data.

Select a game and press A to toggle visibility, or choose Show all games to restore the full list. All console users share the same hidden list. Close a game before changing its visibility. Games may still appear in search, groups or other launchers.

Requires Atmosphere, Tesla Menu and nx-ovlloader. Tested on HOS 22.5.0 / Atmosphere 1.11.2. Extract the release ZIP to the SD card root and fully reboot.

changelog: Initial release. Hide and restore HOME menu games through Tesla.
